summary: Justin Favela discusses his growing art career, including his solo exhibition at the Berman Museum in Collegeville, Pennsylvania, running through December, and a new installation at the Sugar Hill Children's Museum in Harlem opening mid-October. He mentions upcoming projects at the Bury Art Museum in the UK and plans to update his website, justinfavela.com, to better track his schedule. The conversation also covers his podcast 'Latinos Who Lunch,' its success at events like the one in Denver, and the imposter syndrome he experienced earlier in the year. Favela expresses excitement about future meetups in Denver and acknowledges the support from his audience.
